description: This file defines the 'MembershipGossiper' class which handles gossip protocol communication in the Orleans Runtime Membership Service. It includes methods for gossiping status updates to remote silos and a logging mechanism for debugging.

classes.name: MembershipGossiper
classes.description: A class responsible for managing gossip protocol communication among silos in Orleans Cluster membership.

methods.name: GossipToRemoteSilos
methods.description: Sends gossip status updates to a list of remote silo addresses.
